policies.text: A product is added to the municipal procurement directory if it holds green designation and offers a warranty period of at least 10 years.
Electric micro-mobility classification applies when a vehicle's maximum velocity does not exceed 30 km/h.
Commercial listing eligibility requires an annual production volume of at least 5000 units.
Green designation is awarded if a product maintains recycled component content of at least 50%, has a peak efficiency rating of at least 22%, or carries Energy Star verification.
A product meets consumer safety record standards provided product recall incidents do not exceed 0 in a year.
Extended distributor coverage is granted to items maintaining a defect rate below 1% annually.
European commercial authorization is granted to any device holding official CE conformity.
